text:
mira: Heads up — noticed a production crash in our Next sample when deployed to a Vercel Edge function after optimizing for bundle size. Error: "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createClient')". Works in dev (node) but fails in edge build.

sam: ugh. any repro steps or a small zip?

mira: minimal reproduction is the sample-apps/next demo. Steps: `pnpm build` -> `vercel deploy --prod` (edge runtime). Crash happens on first LLM call. Locally `next start` (node) is fine.

jordan: do you have our SDK package.json/exports in the bundle? sometimes bundlers rewrite imports. can you paste package.json from the sdk build?

mira: sure — snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-js",
  "version": "0.9.1",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "sideEffects": false,
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
    }
  }
}
```

sam: sideEffects:false rings a bell — if there's any top-level polyfill/register code that the edge runtime expects, tree-shaking can drop it. do you know if index.mjs imports any module for runtime setup?

mira: yes — index.mjs re-exports a small kv-cache polyfill file: `export * from './kv-cache-shim.js'` and that file also registers a global adapter (side-effect). because we set sideEffects:false the bundler (vite/esbuild) drops it in some prod optimization paths.

jordan: aha. that matches. Vite + esbuild do aggressive pruning. In dev the file gets included because of different resolution, but in optimized edge build it's removed. Solution: mark that file as having side-effects or list it in package.json sideEffects array, or move the registration into an explicit import consumers must call.

alex: quick tests: i tried forcing `import '@redwood/inference-js/dist/kv-cache-shim.js'` in the app root and the edge build stops throwing — so it's definitely the shim being removed.

mira: do we want to change packaging or ask sample apps to import shim? ideally packaging change so consumers don't have to know.

jordan: agree. we should:
- add "sideEffects": ["dist/kv-cache-shim.js"] to package.json OR set sideEffects true
- OR make the shim an explicit entrypoint and list it in exports like "./shim": "./dist/kv-cache-shim.js" so bundlers don't drop it
- add a smoke test for next sample in CI that runs production build + `node --no-experimental-loader` or a simple vercel dev build step

sam: prefer exports entry + explicit import inside index.mjs that isn't only re-export. e.g. `import './kv-cache-shim.js'; export * from './client.js';` but that still counts as side-effect and could be stripped unless sideEffects allows it. so exports + sideEffects array is safest and minimal.

mira: i'll draft a PR. also ran into typing oddities: customers using ts `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` and TS resolves default but ESM build uses named exports. getting a mismatch in some bundler combos.

alex: that's separate but related — ensure package.json `types` points to `dist/index.d.ts` and that `index.d.ts` has `export default` if we provide default import compat. we should ensure both `export =` for cjs and `export default` for esm wrappers.

jordan: propose tasks:
1) PR to add "sideEffects": ["dist/kv-cache-shim.js"] and add "./shim" export (sdk repo) — mira to open
2) add CI smoke (sample-apps/next) that builds production and runs a simple endpoint test — alex to add
3) add a small bundler matrix note (Vite/webpack/esbuild) in devex docs about sideEffects pitfalls — sam to write short blurb

mira: opening PR now, assigning to @devex. PR summary will include a build artifact before/after size diff and local repro instructions.

ci-bot: Created PR #274 by mira: `fix(sdk): mark kv shim as side-effectful and add shim export`

sam: nice. can we also add a unit in our release checklist to test on edge-like runtime? last time we shipped a change that only failed under Cloudflare workers.

jordan: yes — adding a checklist item: "run sample-apps/next production build and verify one sample call against local edge emulator". I'll add to RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md in infra repo.

mira: thanks team — i'll link the PR here once ready. :rocket:

alex: small note for docs: include a recommended `package.json` snippet for libraries that must run in edge runtimes (module+exports+sideEffects array). I can draft that after the PR merges.

mira: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/274 — includes tests and package.json change. please review when you get a sec. :green_heart:
